Static Site SEO Checklist

Ensure search engines love your Jamstack site with structured data and fast payloads.

Even a static site needs intentional SEO. My checklist covers metadata, schema.org markup, XML sitemaps, and render-blocking performance issues. Apply it before every launch and you will avoid the usual scramble to fix search visibility after the fact.
